title.en: Reuse the line along two axes

t.zh: 从 <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> 通关时的电路继续：保留一条轴的三点加权，增加另一条轴的加权路径。方向由常数元件提供，不需要把原电路包成元件。
t.en: Continue the circuit passed in <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>: retain one weighted axis pass and add the other. Constants provide the directions; extend the board directly.

t.zh: 横向与纵向的位置规则已经分别验证，但一次处理仍只覆盖一条线。现在让两次处理共同覆盖二维邻域。你决定两次处理怎样连接，对比亮点的十字和矩形响应。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref> 三点加权器是固定计算的预设元件：接入一根权重向量线，顺序为 [前, 中, 后]。你决定两次处理怎样连接。
t.en: The horizontal and vertical positional rules have been tested separately, but each pass still covers one line. Make two passes cover a 2D neighbourhood. Decide how they connect by comparing cross and rectangular impulse responses. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref> The weighted-line preset accepts one weight-vector wire in [first, centre, last] order. Decide how to connect the two passes.

after.zh:
\[K(u,v)=h(u)h(v)\]

h 是一维权重，u、v 是两个轴的邻域偏移。连续两轴处理时，一个像素先受一轴权重影响，再受另一轴权重影响，因此贡献相乘，形成二维核 K。只有核可写成这种外积、且边界规则一致时，两次一维处理才与二维处理等价。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[K(u,v)=h(u)h(v)\]

h is the one-dimensional weight sequence; u and v are offsets on the two axes. Successive passes multiply the two contributions, producing the outer-product kernel K. Equivalence to a 2D operation requires such a separable kernel and matched border rules. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 使用三点加权器，把给定的 [前, 中, 后] 权重向量先后用于两轴。输出应符合二维外积权重，而不是两张单轴结果相加。横向 (1,0) 和纵向 (0,1) 已由预设电路中的两个常数元件提供。
brief.en: Use the weighted-line preset to apply the supplied [first, centre, last] weight vector along both axes consecutively. Match the 2D outer-product rule rather than adding two single-axis outputs. The starter supplies horizontal (1,0) and vertical (0,1) direction constants.

naiveWhy.zh: 独立处理两轴后相加只覆盖十字形贡献；前后组合才会让角上的邻居参与。
naiveWhy.en: Adding independent passes gives cross-shaped support; serial passes include corner contributions.

hint.zh: 用单个亮点观察角上的贡献从哪里来。两个方向常数只决定取样方向，不改变权重。
hint.en: Use an impulse to inspect corner contributions. The two direction constants select sample directions without changing the weights.
